package.name: g2cell_slam
package.description: SLAM (slam_toolbox) and Nav2 navigation for the mobile AgiBot G2 in the Genie Sim pack-off cell room: lidar PointCloud2 -> LaserScan, mapping and localization+Nav2 launch files, a cmd_vel -> /cmd_twist bridge, a scripted mapping drive, and a NavigateToPose evaluation client.
